items.summary: Swiss data engine Rivia has launched a new AI-powered data review module to speed up clinical data cleaning.

items.title: Could we see 10 Chinese Big Pharmas within a decade? Some CEOs think so
items.summary: For executives at many of the Chinese drug developers who spoke to Fierce, the real prize is a seat at the Big Pharma table. In recent years, this objective has moved from a vague aspiration to a concrete goal.

items.title: BioNTech pays $205M for FDA voucher to speed up ‘late-stage oncology pipeline’
items.summary: BioNTech has agreed to pay $205 million to purchase an FDA priority review voucher to support a future filing of a drug in its “late-stage oncology pipeline.” Fierce breaks down which candidate is most likely to claim the regulatory accelerator.

items.title: Amgen builds Sjögren’s case with detailed phase 3 data ahead of Novartis showdown
items.summary: Amgen has shared more data from a phase 3 Sjögren’s disease trial that dazzled analysts, digging into the details that could shape its showdown with Novartis.

items.title: Capricor, NextCure shed light on recent layoffs as they gear up for approval decision, merger
items.summary: Capricor and NextCure have shed light on recent rounds of layoffs, as the biotechs brace for a hoped-for drug approval and merger, respectively.

items.title: Abbott nabs FDA approval, CE Mark for implantable cardioverter-defibrillator lead
items.summary: Abbott has received both FDA and CE Mark approval for its UltiSynq defibrillation lead tech, which is designed to deliver both conduction system pacing and defibrillation therapy.

items.title: Beam’s sickle cell therapy results tee up potential Casgevy, Lyfgenia showdown
items.summary: Gearing up for a potential FDA filing by the end of the year, Beam Therapeutics revealed results from a phase 1/2 study of its base-edited cell therapy risto-cel, showing the potential sickle cell treatment reduced the most painful complications of the blood disease for a full year.

items.title: Oura to acquire AI virtual primary care partner Counsel Health for $625M
items.summary: The companies have worked together since June, and more recently had shared plans to partner on CMS' 10-year ACCESS Model.

items.title: Start Center for Cancer Research opens first early-phase clinical trial site in Italy
items.summary: Start Center for Cancer Research has expanded into Italy, partnering with Istituti Fisioterapici Ospitalieri to open its first early-phase cancer clinical trial site in the country.

items.title: PepGen’s stock doubles as midphase muscle dystrophy data wow analysts
items.summary: PepGen’s phase 2 myotonic dystrophy type 1 data have met analysts’ best-case scenario, causing the biotech’s share price to more than double.

items.title: AstraZeneca buys partner Omniose for bacterial vaccine technology
items.summary: AstraZeneca has acquired vaccine bioconjugation specialist Omniose, securing technology and expertise that could boost its efforts to protect people from bacterial threats.
